name: SecSight - Notify
description: 通知 — SecSight 契约: execution_argument.target = {channel, message}。L4 自主 (无需审批)。

parameters.name: code
parameters.value:
import json
payload = json.loads($exec)
t = payload.get('target', {})
return {'channel': t.get('channel', 'default'), 'message': t.get('message', ''), 'case_id': payload.get('case_id')}

actions.name: send_notification
actions._comment: 飞书: POST webhook | 钉钉: POST webhook + 加签 | 或 SMTP

_secsight_contract.note: SecSight 已内置飞书/钉钉直连 (app/integrations/notify.py),此 Workflow 为统一走 SOAR 的可选路径
